name: marinara-engine
description: AI Chat & Roleplay Frontend — Conversation, Roleplay, Game
author: Marianna

scripts.build: node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs clean:stale-client && node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs --filter @marinara-engine/shared build && node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs --filter @marinara-engine/server --filter @marinara-engine/client --parallel run build
scripts.check: node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs clean:stale-client && node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs impeccable:check && node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs localization:check && node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs format:check && node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs lint && node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs check:e2e-types && node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs check:token-estimation-types && node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs build
scripts.regression:prompt: node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs build:shared && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/prompt.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/prompt-attachments.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/context-fit.regression.ts
scripts.regression:noodle: node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs build:shared && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/noodle/deletion.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/noodle/feed-seen.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/noodle/image-claim.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/noodle/mentions.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/noodle/platform-migration.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/noodle/polls.regression.ts && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter scripts/regressions/slurp-storage.regression.ts
scripts.regression:security: node ./scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs build:shared && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter security && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter runtime-integrity && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter shell-sandbox && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter extension-ipc && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter android-local-auth && node ./scripts/run-regressions.mjs --filter docker-proxy-auth
